Resolves #19768

Iteration 4 of the 13.3.0 notes (epic #19712) rewrites them for a technical reader new to Neo, from the three outside reads on #19712: [Julia's](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19712#issuecomment-6197291290), [Emmy's](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19712#issuecomment-6197305106) and [a context-free reader's](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19712#issuecomment-6197691336). Every engineering story, source and bound from iteration 3 stays; the order and the vocabulary change.
- The opening starts at the reader's problem (clip the text or pad every row), then says what Neo.mjs is and who builds it.
- The grid chapters are organized around what they guarantee; the one-pixel font case and the recycled-row case lead as case studies.
- Velocity accounting leaves the body; the release-through-PR chapter becomes a section for maintainers after the main arc.
- It ends on a runnable journey through the showcase and a forward view from the roadmap's deferred list.

Related: #19652, #19765, #19761

Evidence: L1 (one docs file; counts and merge attribution read live; every unit spec that reads `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/` run locally) → L1 required (AC-1 to AC-8); AC-9 is this PR's review. Residual: none.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the Shared PR Baseline jobs run in CI.

## Deltas from ticket

- **Length.** The context-free reader asked for half the length; Julia and Emmy asked for orientation and a closing. Prose before the changelog stays about level with iteration 3 (about 3.6k words), and the main arc from the TL;DR to the war story is about a sixth shorter, since the release chapter moved out and the accounting left. If the review wants more cut, *Also in 13.3* and the maintainers' section are the candidates.
- **Velocity.** The release-notes skill's precedent set prizes clock-time case studies; all three reads took the durations for haste. This iteration drops them from the body, and the linked pull requests keep the dates. Changing the skill's bar is out of scope here.
- **Two *Also* items left,** because the upgrade table states the same facts (`NEO_DEAD_PORT`, `canvasLoadFailed`), and so did the hidden grid's measuring retries (#19688 stays in the changelog).
- **Live links.** On neomjs.com, `examples/grid/bigData` answers today; `examples/grid/issues` and `examples/grid/contentSizedRows` answer once 13.3.0 publishes and the site rebuilds, the first only if #19761 merges before the cut. The cut-prep (#19765) re-checks both links after the deploy, and the *Who builds it* merge sentence at the cut head.
